Contract Backend / Platform Engineer (independent contractor)

We need a contractor who can join an existing AWS-hosted platform team and ship
Python services without a long ramp. This is a 6-month contract, remote.

Must-haves:
- Python services and REST APIs
- AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch)
- Docker and a practical CI/CD path (GitHub Actions is fine)
- PostgreSQL
- Comfortable as an independent contractor on a scoped engagement

Nice-to-haves:
- Redis
- infrastructure-as-code experience
- on-call / production support habits

You will ingest partner events, keep batch jobs from double-processing, and
work with the platform team on IAM and S3 practices. We do not need you to
rebuild the org or invent a new stack.
